definitions.explanation: a minor skin injury caused by rubbing against a rough surface

examples.japanese: ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{擦|す}り{傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I got a scrape on my knee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧{擦|す}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I fell and got a scrape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擦|す}り{傷|きず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消毒液|しょうどくえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied disinfectant to the child's scrape.

notes:
USAGE:
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (to get a scrape)
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to get/make a scrape)
- {擦|す}り{傷|きず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to treat a scrape)
A very common minor injury, especially for children who play outdoors. Typically from falling on asphalt or concrete.

ALTERNATE READING:
Also written as すりきず without kanji in informal contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{切|き}り{傷|きず}→切り傷：07340_kirikizu⟧ (cut wound)
- ⟦{打撲|だぼく}→打撲：05017_daboku⟧ (bruise)
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧ (wound, injury - general)
